title: The Genie One desktop app for Windows is in Beta
body: The Genie One desktop app is now available for Windows in [Beta](/aws/en/release-notes/release-types), in addition to macOS. The native app opens Genie One on your desktop instead of in a browser tab, so business users can chat with data in natural language, work with their threads and documents, and use Genie Agents without a browser. See [Windows](/aws/en/genie-one/desktop#install-windows).
